messages:
mike: Quick callout — we need a concise playbook for when to bump patch vs minor and how to tag deps-only pins. also need rollback thresholds for release tomorrow.

jess: +1. TL;DR rules? patch = bugfix/no user-facing API change; minor = feature or contract change. deps-only = patch w/ +pin buildmeta.

ashley: Agree on rules. Proposal for tags: `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` for prod releases. For deps-only pin bumps use `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH+pin.N` (build metadata). e.g., `v1.4.2+pin.1`. That keeps semver ordering and makes intent explicit.

tom: Question: will CI treat +pin.1 as same semver? npm/npm-like registries ignore buildmeta for precedence — but our git tags are fine. We shouldn't publish a new package version with just buildmeta in package.json. This is repo-level tagging only.

sara: Rollback policy suggestion: auto-roll if error-rate >3% or 5xx increase >100% for 5m during canary; immediate rollback if data-corrupting bug found. Add monitoring for latency regressions: p95 > baseline *1.25 for 10m -> alert for manual rollback.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary to 2% on prod-us-west (sha abc123). Monitoring hooks enabled. If any threshold tripped, stage will be paused.

mike: Can we make a short checklist for engineers performing pin bumps? e.g., 1) confirm test coverage, 2) run smoke in staging, 3) tag with +pin.N, 4) add release-note line 'deps: pin X->Y', 5) if risk low, direct patch release else schedule during change window.

jess: love checklist. Also add: update CHANGELOG.md entry with 'deps-only' label and link to dependency diff. Keep commits squashed and reference issue.

ashley: For rollback communication: use /deploy rollback <tag> and on Slack post template:
```
Rollback initiated: <release-tag>
Reason: <short-reason>
Rollback owner: @owner
ETA: 10m
```

tom: small nit: prefer `rollback-owner` field in the template for clarity. otherwise :+1:

sara: I'll add thresholds to Dashboard and make an automated alert that pings #eng-oncall + release owner.

mike: OK let's adopt: tagging = base semver + `+pin.N` for pins, patch/minor as usual. Rollback thresholds as above. Update release docs and I'll send release-note template. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
